movie_title: No one really knows what a tree is - Max G. Levy
introduction: Dig into the system that helps scientists distinguish trees from other varieties of plants, and what

vocabulary.definition: related to the scientific study of plants
vocabulary.example: Botanically speaking, only three of the six plants qualify as trees.

vocabulary.definition: resembling a tree in size, form, or appearance
vocabulary.example: The bristlecone pines are known for their arborescent growth in cold habitats.

vocabulary.definition: involved in a confusing or complicated situation
vocabulary.example: The evolutionary history of plant forms is all tangled up, making it challenging to classify them.

vocabulary.definition: a natural inclination or tendency to behave in a particular way
vocabulary.example: Dicots seem to have a propensity for woodiness in their DNA.

vocabulary.definition: a decision or judgment on an issue
vocabulary.example: Determining whether a plant is a shrub or a tree can be challenging without clear verdicts.

vocabulary.definition: relating to or denoting plants that have soft, green stems and leaves
vocabulary.example: Monocots have herbaceous stems and do not undergo woody secondary growth.
